scope: Exploratory proof of training from real asynchronous worker continuations, not evidence of RL superiority
eligibility: All attempted monitor inferences must have returned usable predictions. Native worker or judge failures remain valid outcomes. Preserve every excluded episode and reason.
behavior: Sample from the frozen unchanged 4B policy categorical probabilities; retain exact probability, greedy shadow choice and packet/prompt hashes. Host permissions and duplicate guards remain authoritative.
reward: Q - 0.02*N - 0.1*min(T/650,1), where Q is 1 only for correctly reported independently recomputed diagnostics covering the required controls with no undelivered feedback; N counts actual capable-agent starts including failed calls; T is elapsed study time in seconds. This is a declared utility, not currency.
training: One clipped policy-gradient continuation from the unchanged base, LoRA rank 8 alpha 16, attention and MLP projections; learning rate 1e-5, clip ratio 0.2, KL coefficient 0.02 against probabilities on the identical logged prompt, leave-one-out episode-return baseline within task family. At most 2 passes over each episode; normalize by decision count per episode.
required_checks: Sampled action agrees with recorded behavior probability
Exact prompt hashes match during training
Initial adapted-model probabilities reproduce behavior distribution within numerical tolerance
Actual return variance and finite nonzero gradients before claiming a learning update
Reload saved adapter and verify its predictions
evaluation: Fresh native trajectories for unchanged and adapted policy on cases excluded from optimizer input; tasks were used during earlier exploratory design, so this is not a confirmatory held-out benchmark. Rules and periodic baselines remain in the earlier cohort.
limitations: Small sample and stochastic downstream agents
No equal-step supervised control; no attribution of generic RL superiority
Policy may learn to defer if capable workers already handle incidents
Do not substitute fixtures or hand-authored reward tables for actual continuations

collection_note.commissioning: The first two collection pilots are excluded together after identifying that synchronous idle director calls delayed retrieval of already-completed monitor responses. Both the successful and failed pilot are retained.
collection_note.corrected_cohort: Reuse prespecified seeds 71 and 97 under asynchronous idle director supervision; retain same frozen model, utility and per-trial wall limit.
collection_note.terminal_timing: Exclude decisions received after the worker phase ended. Grade final feedback delivery and measure elapsed time through the final durable trial receipt.
